notes: 3.4.0's headline feature never ran. The Model panel reported every sector model as refused: Cannot find module './blocks/reit-ffo' and the Standing page listed one model instead of four. Not a logic error — a bundling one, which is why every test passed. The server is bundled by esbuild into a single file, and a bundler can only follow a require whose path it can read at build time.
